Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Know Their Minds
Cards.Text: Open: Bow your performing Samurai: Choose a player. He chooses a face-up Personality in one of his provinces. Turn the Personality face-down.

Cards.Name: Scandalous Rumors
Cards.Text: Battle: Bow your performing Courtier at any location: The Attacker may target any of his Personalities at the current battlefield and move them home. He loses 1 Honor for each of his Personalities there that this did not move, then dishonors them.
